confirmation_rule: custom candidate must pass all gates in both equal-data and equal-compute runs
english_scope: equal-intent mean across en-bn, en-bl and en-en; point regression guard with uncertainty reported
runtime_scope: all three seeds: warm batch-1 tokenize + encode + exact cached-document search and fresh-process peak RSS
uncertainty_scope: paired crossed resampling of training seeds and intent groups
version_2_note: Measurement interpretations frozen before adapted-model development scoring; numerical thresholds unchanged
final_test_rule: freeze selection before final test; no tuning on test
provenance_rule: report agent authorship/judgment; never claim human review
comparison_rule: same encoder body/data/objective; count initialization and adaptation cost
